_notice: Source of truth for the HYDLNK Stripe catalog (prices confirmed by Gary, 2026-10-02). A price cannot be edited in Stripe once it exists: changing an amount here makes setup-live.sh create a new price and move the lookup key to it. Change an amount only on purpose, and update docs/PLAN.md and src/lib/billing/prices.ts with it.
_howto: setup-live.sh finds or creates each product and each price (matched by lookup_key) from this file. unit_amount is in cents. A price with enabled=false is never created and is left out of the customer portal. Product metadata is also copied onto its prices, together with the interval. tax_code is left alone while it is null; set it (for example txcd_10103001, SaaS for business use) once the tax decision in docs/stripe-go-live.md is made. pricesConfirmed is the explicit go-ahead: setup-live.sh refuses --live --apply unless it is true.
